description: Raw bytes entering the CAS. PUT /cas is an admission of this Kind: the kernel hashes the body, builds this spec, runs the pipeline, and writes the bytes only as the admit step of a granted admission. The payload never carries the bytes.

claims: the recorded actor stored bytes of this size at this content address at the recorded position on the chain
doesNotClaim: anything about the bytes' meaning, origin, or media type beyond the recorded label
that the recorded actor held the key whose fingerprint is recorded — admissions are not yet signed by their actors
